text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh...!!
Haa... haa... *cough*...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(My legs... feel heavier than ever before.
And what's more...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe it's because I've spent more time thinking lately,
...but my head is spinning.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Even the sights from the race just now... are starting to spin round and round...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Looks like my sleep will be light again tonight.)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Light O-san.
Thank you for your hard work."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm completely exhausted.
Races are always like that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Listen to me, Believe. You look like you're about to collapse from exhaustion yourself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—I won't worry.
Like I told you before.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—I don't need it, as I've said before.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Fatigue. It's clinging to me, without a doubt.
Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —If it has been accomplished, then that is fine.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With footsteps that clearly showed her exhaustion,
Believe returned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's painful to see. I want to comfort her first.
Swallowing down those overflowing emotions, though,
I must first say what needs to be said.
choice_data_list: Believe... You've turned out beautifully, haven't you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Acceleration without hesitation.
Pace without faltering.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I was able to run fast.
...Very fast.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I will, always... always.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I wanted to seize a result that reflected my hard work.
choice_data_list: You're right. All that's left... is the real thing.
Yeah. Next up is... the real thing.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
The Sprinters Stakes.
On the grandest stage—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I shall deliver the finest work possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was practically no time to prepare. Forget training, there wasn't even time to get in peak condition.
Even so, she gave a firm, confident nod.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will face the big race on a tight turnaround.
That's what I decided, so I'll see it through.
That's all there is to it. —That's all.
choice_data_list: Let's show them the culmination of our work!
Let's show them the culmination of our work!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: —Speed is what matters most, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"...It's just like my job.
Being fast is what matters most."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —I will.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I will show you that I can become the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Believe
Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I can't actually run, but...
If I'm just watching the track—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, yaaawn...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!?
B-Believe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Good evening, Dants-san.
Did you... just finish training?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. Ahaha...
That high-intensity, low-rep training you taught me in summer is still tough without taking breaks...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Between putting the finishing touches on for the Kikuka Sho
and handling all sorts of other stuff...
it got so late before I knew it. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I see. ...You must be exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, not at all!
Not even close... or rather—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um. Believe-chan, are you in uniform...?
You wrapped up training early, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since it's a recovery-focused routine.
I spend the rest of the time on visualization training.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Did that make you nervous?
Or maybe not nervous, but uneasy—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! S-Sorry if I got it wrong!?
Um, I mess these things up a lot, so...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're not wrong.
I was feeling a bit restless, so I thought looking out at the grounds would help calm me down.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I must train my mental fortitude further.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!!
You're already doing plenty, Believe-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's enough... Just running your heart out on a schedule like this is already more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible. You're always... always, always
working so hard—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: You're working hard too, aren't you, Dants-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh...... Wait, me!?
N-No way, not at all!
Not even close, I still have a long way... Not one bit—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No.
I was watching by your side all summer, at least.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Dants-san was giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: She really had been trying her best every single day.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Switching race routes is no easy task.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I have to do a different kind of training.
I have to fight through the pain of an unfamiliar physical strain.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, there's no guarantee it'll work out.
In the end, you never know until you actually run.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you kept doing your best.
Properly, day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Properly.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Even now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm... not the kind of girl who deserves
those kinds of words.
I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... if it were Believe-chan,
she would've pulled it off with a far cooler look on her face than me, and—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know.
I've never done it before.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
“You're doing it, though.
You're seeing it through to the end.”

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That is all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I should get going soon.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Make sure you don't let your body get cold.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Am I doing... okay? Am I really doing my best...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Why... do I keep trying so hard...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Giving it my all, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'll do my best too.
